_comment: Hand-supplied portraits, applied last so they beat anything the automatic passes chose. This is the escape hatch for the case no matcher can solve: an entry that is confidently wrong rather than missing. Wikidata's 'Shankar' is S. Shankar the Tamil director (born 1963), which matched the name exactly and passed every occupation check — nothing but a person saying 'no, this one' can correct that. `subject` records who the picture actually shows, which for a duo is both members. These images carry no open licence and are listed as such on the about page.
